diagnosis: The user is inquiring about the retirement of the /v1/reporting endpoint. According to the deprecation timeline, traffic to these endpoints will cease on 2026-11-01, and customers should migrate to the v2 reporting API.
reply: The v1 reporting endpoints will stop accepting traffic on November 1, 2026. We recommend updating your dashboard to use the v2 reporting API, which returns the same fields within a paginated envelope. If you need assistance with the migration, please let us know.
